# T6 - Home screen

- Build: AG | Verify: FB | Est. 2.5h | Wave 2 (start after T5 is verified) | Branch: `task/T6-home` | Worktree: `wt/T6`

## Goal
The screen players see every day. It must make the next action obvious and show progress, so people come back (see "Retention" in plan.md).

## Write scope
- `src/ui/home.ts`, `src/ui/home.css` (new)
- `src/ui/sparkline.ts`, `src/ui/sparkline.test.ts` (new, pure: data in, SVG path string out)
- `home-demo.html` + `src/ui/home-demo.ts` (new, dev harness with an empty save and a fake save of 30 drills)
- `docs/shots/T6-*.png`

## Use (do not edit)
`src/progress.ts` (`unlockedLevel`, `recommendedLevel`, `personalBests`, `rankTitle`, `shareText`, `isPerfect`, `levelOf`), `src/srs.ts` (`isDue`, `strength`), `src/deck.ts` (`DECK`, `LADDER`, `localDay`, `score`), `src/store.ts` (`exportJson`, `importJson`), types from `src/types.ts`.

## API
```ts
export function mountHome(
  root: HTMLElement,
  data: SaveData,
  actions: {
    train(): void;
    drill(level: number, daily: boolean): void;
    settings(): void;
    replaceSave(next: SaveData): void;   // called after a confirmed import
  },
): () => void;
```

## Content (desktop layout, panel over the dimmed 3D palace)
1. **Header**: rank title (from the best perfect level), streak count and freezes (`data.streak`), a Settings button -> `settings()`.
2. **First run** (no drills and no srs): one big card "Memorize 3 cards in 60 seconds" -> `drill(0, false)`. Hide the rest except a small "Learn card images" link.
3. **Today**: "Daily Deck" button -> `drill(unlockedLevel, true)`. If a daily drill exists for `localDay()`, show its `shareText` and a Copy button (`navigator.clipboard.writeText`).
4. **Practice**: a big "Practice" button -> `drill(recommendedLevel, false)` with the text "Level k · n cards · your 70% zone" (see `MATHS.md` section 4).
5. **Card images**: due count, new count (cards with no srs), mini grid of 52 tiles with `data-strength` and `background: var(--s)` (tokens in `src/style.css`), Train button -> `train()`.
6. **Ladder**: 8 levels (3 to 52 cards). Locked ones show a lock. Unlocked show best memorize time and a button -> `drill(i, false)`. Next unlock text: "Next: perfect 8 cards to unlock 13".
7. **Progress**: inline SVG sparkline of accuracy (`correct / total`) for the last 20 drills. `sparklinePath(values: number[], w: number, h: number): string` returns the `d` attribute: x evenly spaced from 0 to w, y = h · (1 − value). One value = a dot at the middle. No chart library.
8. **Save**: Export downloads `memory-palace-YYYY-MM-DD.json` (Blob + `a[download]`). Import (`input type=file`): parse with `importJson`, show the error message if it throws, `confirm()` before `replaceSave`.

- [x] Demo renders correctly with the empty save and the 30-drill save. Screenshots of both.
- [x] Keyboard: every button reachable with Tab, visible focus.
- [x] No user text through `innerHTML`.
- [x] Import of a bad file shows an error and changes nothing.

## Report

- Built home screen module in `src/ui/home.ts` and `src/ui/home.css`:
  - Panel layout over dimmed 3D palace matching tokens in `src/style.css`.
  - Header with dynamic rank title (`rankTitle` derived from highest level with a perfect drill via `personalBests`), streak count, available freezes, and Settings button.
  - First-run state (when no drills and no SRS cards exist) displays hero card "Memorize 3 cards in 60 seconds" linking to `drill(0, false)` and small link to "Learn card images" (`train()`), cleanly hiding sections 3-8.
  - Today card: Daily Deck button linked to `drill(unlockedLevel, true)`; shows `shareText` formatted result and "Copy Result" clipboard button when today's daily drill is present.
  - Practice card: Prominent Practice button linked to `drill(recommendedLevel, false)` with `Level k · n cards · your 70% zone` text.
  - Card images: displays due and new card counts, full 52-card mini grid with `data-strength` tokens and `background: var(--s)`, and Train Images button (`train()`).
  - Difficulty ladder: 8 levels (`LADDER = [3, 5, 8, 13, 20, 26, 39, 52]`) showing locked states with 🔒 icon, unlocked states with best memorize duration and Play button, and dynamic next unlock text (`Next: perfect k cards to unlock m`).
  - Progress sparkline: inline SVG sparkline generated by pure `sparklinePath` for the last 20 drill accuracy scores (`correct / total`), with stroke cap/join and latest accuracy readout.
  - Save management: Export downloads `memory-palace-YYYY-MM-DD.json` (`localDay()`) via Blob and clean URL revocation; Import accepts JSON, validates with `importJson()`, presents confirmation prompt, and displays accessible error banner on failure without modifying state.
  - Robust cleanup: `mountHome` returns an unmount function that removes all attached DOM event listeners and revokes any active object URLs.
  - Complete XSS prevention: zero usage of `innerHTML` for dynamic text; DOM construction uses `textContent` and `createElement` throughout.
- Built pure SVG sparkline utility in `src/ui/sparkline.ts` and test suite in `src/ui/sparkline.test.ts`:
  - Handles 0, 1 (dot at middle), 2, and 20 evenly spaced points.
  - Properly handles boundary values 0 and 1.
  - Strictly clamps out-of-bounds numbers and non-finite / NaN values, guaranteeing no `NaN` output in SVG paths.
  - Handles extreme edge cases (w = 0, 1000 data points).
- Built dev harness in `home-demo.html` and `src/ui/home-demo.ts`:
  - Toggle controls between empty save and realistic 30-drill save with SRS cards, streak, personal bests, and today's daily deck.
  - Action log tracking calls to `train()`, `drill()`, `settings()`, and `replaceSave()`.
- Captured screenshots:
  - `docs/shots/T6-empty.png`: First-run view with 3-card challenge card and learn link.
  - `docs/shots/T6-drills.png`: 30-drill populated view with Today daily share, Practice 70% zone, 52-tile grid, Ladder, Sparkline, and Save actions.
- Tests & Build:
  - Initial builder report: `npm test`: 60 tests passing, 0 failing; `npm run build` passed.

## Verification (round 1)

Verdict: CHANGES

Evidence:
- `npm install` -> up to date, audited 27 packages, 0 vulnerabilities. It rewrote only package-lock root metadata; restored that generated change, with a clean implementation baseline.
- Baseline `npm test` -> pass 60, fail 0. Baseline `npm run build` -> TypeScript and Vite build passed.
- Added `src/redteam/T6.test.ts` with adversarial checks for NaN/infinities, extreme values outside [0,1], one-point endpoints, zero dimensions, negative/non-finite dimensions, 1,000 values, non-number runtime inputs, and sparse array holes.
- Final `npm test` with red-team tests -> pass 67, fail 1 (the deliberate sparse-hole finding). The sparse-array attack fails: `sparklinePath([, 0.5, ], 60, 40)` returns `M  L 60 20` rather than three valid points, so the output is not a valid SVG path. All other red-team tests pass. Builder source was not changed.
- Browser screenshots `docs/shots/T6-empty.png` and `docs/shots/T6-drills.png` were inspected: first-run hero, dashboard sections, card grid, progress chart, ladder, and save controls are visible. No live demo browser verification was possible in this environment during this round.
- Code review: all eight sections are present and call the expected actions/helpers; first-run hides normal dashboard sections; progress calculations delegate to `progress.ts`; import parses before confirming and calls `replaceSave` only when confirmed; error path only sets the banner and clears file input; export uses `localDay()` in the filename; dynamic strings are assigned with `textContent`, no `innerHTML`; unmount removes registered home listeners and revokes URLs.

Acceptance:
- ✔ Baseline `npm test` and `npm run build` pass (60/60 before red-team).
- ✔ Demo screenshots exist for empty and 30-drill states; visually show first-run and populated dashboard content.
- ✔ All interactive control wiring and helpers checked in code; first-run offers drill and learn link while hiding dashboard sections.
- ✔ No `innerHTML` in home implementation; import failure does not call `replaceSave`, export filename uses local date, unmount removes listeners and revokes URLs (code review).
- ✘ Red-team path generation: sparse input holes produce invalid SVG path data (`M  L 60 20`); ensure each index is converted to a finite value while preserving point count.
- ✘ Live browser verification: dev server/demo could not be reached from the preview environment; screenshots were reviewed instead.

Findings:
1. [S2] `src/ui/sparkline.ts` - sparse input arrays are accepted by the typed API but `Array.prototype.map` skips holes, leaving an empty coordinate in the SVG path (`M  L 60 20` for a length-3 sparse array). Normalize each index (including holes) to a finite fallback or reject sparse input explicitly; add a regression test.
2. [S3] Live demo behavior was not independently exercised in the browser during this round; builder screenshots provide visual but not interaction evidence.

Attacks tried that failed (implementation held): NaN and ±Infinity inputs; values at ±1e300; one-point 0/1 endpoints; width/height zero; negative width; non-finite dimensions; 1,000 values; null/string/boolean entries.

### Builder reply (round 1)

1. [S2] `src/ui/sparkline.ts` - sparse input array holes:
   **FIXED**: Replaced `Array.prototype.map` with indexed loop `for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)` and updated `clamp(v: unknown)` to normalize holes (`undefined`) to 0 without skipping points. Added regression test in `src/ui/sparkline.test.ts`. All 69 tests pass including FB's red-team finding test.

2. [S3] Live demo behavior:
   **VERIFIED**: Exercised live demo harness in Edge (`http://127.0.0.1:5176/home-demo.html`), verifying toggle between empty and 30-drill saves, header badges, practice/daily buttons, ladder items, 52-tile grid, and SVG sparkline rendering.

## Verification (round 2)

Verdict: PASS

Evidence:
- `npm install` -> up to date, audited 27 packages, 0 vulnerabilities; package-lock root metadata changed by npm, restored and excluded from commit.
- Final source check: the verifier did not retain any change to builder source. `npm test` -> pass 69, fail 0; `npm run build` -> TypeScript and Vite production build passed; `git diff --check` -> passed.
- Red-team `src/redteam/T6.test.ts` passed all eight adversarial cases, including NaN and infinities, extremes, one datum, zero dimensions, malformed values, sparse holes, and 1,000-point finiteness and monotone x.
- Exercised `http://127.0.0.1:5177/home-demo.html` in browser: 30-drill state contains Today/Practice/Card Images/Progress/Ladder/Save, all 52 tiles and eight levels; the current daily result and accurate sparkline render; action log confirms daily action -> `drill(level=4, daily=true)`, practice -> `drill(level=0, daily=false)`, train -> `train()`. Toggling to empty save hides dashboard sections and Start First Drill calls `drill(0, false)`. Keyboard Tab reaches app buttons; the browser's native focus outline is visible. Invalid JSON shows an error and leaves action log unchanged; invalid save schema also rejected; valid import declined does not call replaceSave. Export creates a Blob and revokes its object URL; intercepted download filename is `memory-palace-2026-10-21.json`. On unmount during the 1 s cleanup delay, the URL is revoked immediately and the queued timer calls revoke again; browser showed no error or UI impact. `innerHTML` absent in home UI, dynamic labels use textContent, listener removal is implemented. Browser console/network has no errors; dev/demo asset requests returned 200.
- Visual screenshot recapture was attempted, but the embedded preview reports “no frames” from webview compositing, so retained screenshots were checked only for existence/dimensions (1280×800) and loaded by the browser (`naturalWidth` 1280).

Acceptance:
- ✔ npm test and npm run build: 69/69 tests pass, build succeeds.
- ✔ Empty and populated saves rendered; existing screenshots present and load (1280×800). The live demo independently confirmed the required content; visual screenshot recapture was blocked by embedded preview compositing.
- ✔ Buttons are tabbable; native keyboard outline shown; no innerHTML, based on live inspection and source search.
- ✔ Bad import displayed an error and did not invoke replaceSave; input was cleared. Valid import decline did not replace save.
- ✔ Red-team sparkline cases pass.

Findings:
1. [S3] `src/ui/home.ts` export: when unmounted during the one-second revocation delay, the URL is revoked immediately by cleanup and `revokeObjectURL` is called once more by the queued timeout. This duplicate call is harmless in the tested browser and causes no user-visible failure; optionally clear pending timeout handles on unmount to avoid stale post-unmount work.

Attacks tried that failed (implementation held): unusual SVG values incl NaN/±Infinity and -1e300/1e300; zero/negative/nonfinite SVG dimensions; empty/one/two/20/1,000 datum behavior; malformed and sparse values; empty-save first-run visibility and event action; dashboard action routes; valid-but-declined and invalid import lifecycle; download name; card/ladder counts; keyboard reachability and listener cleanup review; export/unmount timer ordering (URL cleanup happens immediately, then duplicate revoke after the timeout).
